remarks: Live the coastal lifestyle every day in this desirable Shippan condo, where beachside living sets the tone from the moment you arrive. Welcome to Marina Bay, a community known for its relaxed lifestyle and unbeatable waterfront amenities. Move right in and start enjoying this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse-style unit that blends comfort, style, and convenience.  Inside, you'll find gleaming floors, a sun-filled living room with a cozy fireplace, and a dining area that opens to a spacious balcony-an ideal spot for morning coffee or unwinding after a long day. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite counters, and excellent storage. A stylish half bath completes the first level.  Upstairs, two generously sized bedrooms offer plenty of space and privacy. The primary suite includes an updated bath, walk-in closet, and its own private balcony for peaceful outdoor moments. The second bedroom is large, with an updated bath featuring a walk-in shower just steps away. A full-size washer and dryer on this level add everyday convenience.  Marina Bay residents enjoy a private waterfront in-ground pool, a clubhouse with a kitchen for gatherings, and close proximity to beaches, marinas, parks, soccer fields, tennis courts, I-95, and Metro North. Additional conveniences include kayak racks, bike storage rooms, and ample visitor parking. With its unbeatable location and inviting amenities, Marina Bay is truly a place you'll be proud to call home.
